value.rationale: The new result is not simply a zero moment: it matches the entire Gaussian first-order null distribution at a continuum of positive real-analytic fixed alternatives, giving exact nominal limiting rejection probability while their KS separation is at least |c|/4. It identifies a meaningful calibration and consistency boundary for a published scalar nonparametric test; this does not apply to its integrated-square cousin or censored version.
